The implementation is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I did:

## New API in `layer_manager.rs`

- **`LayerManagerLockHolder` enum** — publicly accessible (`pub(crate)`) from `crate::tenant::timeline::layer_manager`, with a `Testing` variant plus subsystem-specific variants (`GetLayerMapInfo`, `GenerateHeatmap`, `GetPage`, `Init`, `DetachAncestor`, `ImportPgData`, `Compaction`, `GarbageCollection`, `Shutdown`, `Eviction`, `Flush`, `FreezeLayer`, `GetLayerForWrite`).
- **`LockedLayerManager`** — a wrapper struct around `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` (the old field type). It exposes:
  - `async fn read(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerReadGuard<'_>`
  - `async fn write(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerWriteGuard<'_>`
  - plus `try_read`/`try_write` (also taking a holder), since callers used those too.
- **`LayerManagerReadGuard`/`LayerManagerWriteGuard`** — type aliases over the tokio guards, so all existing guard usages (`.layer_map()`, `.open_mut()`, etc.) keep working unchanged.

The `Timeline.layers` field changed from `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` to `LockedLayerManager` (it still derives `Default`, so `layers: Default::default()` is untouched).

## Callers updated

All 71+ lock acquisitions across 13 source files now pass a contextually appropriate holder — e.g. `Compaction` in `compaction.rs`, `DetachAncestor` in `detach_ancestor.rs`, `Eviction`, `GarbageCollection`, `Flush`, etc., and `LayerManagerLockHolder::Testing` in all `#[cfg(test)]` code.

## Verification

- `cargo check -p pageserver --all-targets` compiles cleanly with **no warnings or errors**.
- No files under any `tests/` directory were modified (the changed `layer/tests.rs` is a source module, not in a `tests/` dir).
- No holder-less layers-lock calls remain.

One design note: since the holder is currently just an identifier for observability, the wrapper accepts it (`_holder`) without acting on it yet — the plumbing is in place for attributing held locks to subsystems.
